topStories.headline: Italy City Council Upholds Officer Kevin 'Blue' Oginski's Firing in Tense 3-2 Vote
topStories.dek: The Italy City Council voted 3-2 last week to uphold the termination of a veteran officer, drawing sharp public division and backlash.
topStories.body:
The Italy City Council voted 3-2 to uphold the firing of veteran officer Kevin "Blue" Oginski in a decision the Ellis County Press, which reported the vote on September 30, 2026, described as one that "sparked deep division and public backlash." The meeting took place the prior week, placing it in the latter half of September.

Italy is a small city of roughly 2,166 residents in southern Ellis County. Its city government includes Mayor Clinton Sulak-Tovar and a five-member city council, according to the Texas Municipal League directory. The 3-2 margin indicates at least two council members voted against upholding the termination.

The specific grounds for Oginski's original dismissal and the arguments presented at the council hearing were not detailed in the summary available at press time. The Ellis County Press article was behind a subscription paywall; readers seeking the full account can contact Italy City Hall or access the Press directly. No public statement from Oginski or city officials was found in open sources as of this writing.

topStories.headline: Texas AG Sides with Ennis Police Department in Open-Records Ruling
topStories.dek: The Attorney General's Office published a ruling last week finding that the Ennis Police Department may withhold records sought in a request filed by Matt Zajic.
topStories.body:
The Texas Attorney General's Office published a ruling siding with the Ennis Police Department in an open-records dispute, according to a report in the Ellis County Press dated September 30, 2026. The Press noted the AG's decision appeared the prior week, placing the ruling in the week of September 22.

The request was filed by Matt Zajic. Under Texas Government Code Chapter 552, when a governmental body seeks to withhold public information it must request an AG opinion; a ruling "with" the governmental body means the AG agreed that some or all of the requested records may be lawfully withheld. The specific categories of records at issue were not detailed in the published summary.

The full AG letter ruling is publicly searchable through the Office of the Attorney General's Open Records portal at texasattorneygeneral.gov. The Ennis Police Department is based at Ennis City Hall, 107 N. Sherman St.

topStories.headline: Stars of Texas Opens This Weekend at the Motorplex with Aaron Watson, Brad Paisley and Travis Tritt
topStories.dek: The sixth annual Stars of Texas Music Festival runs October 9–11 at the Texas Motorplex, kicking off the ten-day Stampede of Speed.
topStories.body:
The Stars of Texas Music Festival returns to the Texas Motorplex in Ennis this Friday for its sixth and self-described biggest year yet, running October 9–11, 2026. The festival opens the Stampede of Speed, a ten-day stretch of events at the Motorplex that culminates with the NHRA Texas Fall Nationals.

The country music lineup puts Aaron Watson onstage Friday evening, Brad Paisley on Saturday, and Travis Tritt on Sunday. Alongside the music, the weekend includes drag racing, bull riding, BBQ, a kids zone, fireworks, and the festival's signature sky-lantern release after dark on Saturday and Sunday nights, according to the Texas Motorplex's own announcements.

The Texas Motorplex is located at 7500 US-287 in Ennis, roughly 40 minutes south of Dallas. Friday gates open at 3:00 PM; Saturday and Sunday programming begins at noon. Single-day general admission for Saturday starts at $69 in advance; Sunday general admission is available for $44 online starting October 3. Three-day passes are also on sale. Full schedule and ticket details are at starsoftexas.com.

The Motorplex's Stampede of Speed continues the following week, with NHRA qualifying on October 14–15 and elimination rounds October 16–18.

events.description: The first grading period ends Thursday, October 8. October 9 is a staff development day with no school for students, and October 12 is the district's Columbus Day holiday. The second grading period begins Tuesday, October 13.

events.description: Three-night country festival headlined by Aaron Watson (Friday), Brad Paisley (Saturday), and Travis Tritt (Sunday), with drag racing, bull riding, BBQ, a kids zone, and lantern releases each night. Tickets at starsoftexas.com.

events.description: The Ellis County Commissioners Court holds its regular meeting. Agendas are posted 72 hours in advance at elliscountytx.gov.

events.description: The NHRA Texas Fall Nationals features Top Fuel, Funny Car, Pro Stock, and Pro Stock Motorcycle racing as part of the Countdown to the Championship in NHRA's 75th season. Qualifying October 14–15; eliminations October 16–18. Tickets from $41.

moreNews.headline: Voter Registration Deadline for November Election Is Monday, October 5
moreNews.body: Texas Secretary of State Robert S. Howden reminded Texans on September 28 that the deadline to register to vote — or update an existing registration — for the November 3, 2026 General Election is Monday, October 5, 2026. Ellis County residents can check or update their registration at VoteTexas.gov. Early voting in Ellis County runs October 19–30, with vote-center locations available countywide. Election Day is November 3.

moreNews.headline: Ellis County Burn Ban Remains in Effect Since July 21
moreNews.body: The countywide burn ban put in place by the Ellis County Commissioners' Court on July 21, 2026 remains active as of this week, according to the Ellis County website. The ban covers all unincorporated areas of the county — including areas around Ennis, Ferris, Palmer, Italy, and Alma — and prohibits brush piles, trash fires, campfires, and any other open outdoor burning. Residents should check elliscountytx.gov for updates on when the ban is lifted.

moreNews.headline: Ennis Main Street and EDC Launch Downtown Small Business Toolkit
moreNews.body: The Ennis Main Street Board and the Ennis Economic Development Corporation announced the launch of a Downtown Small Business Toolkit on September 9, 2026. The free resource is intended to help entrepreneurs navigate the process of opening or expanding a business in the downtown district. It accompanies a Small Business Training and Development Series that has brought guest speakers and workshops to local business owners throughout 2026. Details are available at ennistx.gov.

restaurants.name: Fern In The Wild
restaurants.type: Modern farm-to-table restaurant, espresso bar and boutique
restaurants.description: Seasonal American dishes, weekend brunch, craft cocktails, and a full espresso bar inside a downtown Ennis space that doubles as a curated retail boutique.

restaurants.name: Ruston Cattle Company
restaurants.description: Family-owned steakhouse and BBQ serving local Texas wagyu hand-cut and seared to order alongside house-smoked specialties and bold sides in a casual picnic-table setting.
restaurants.address: 3701 N I-45 Frontage Rd, Ennis, TX 75119

restaurants.name: Ashleigh's Downtown Kitchen + Bar
restaurants.description: Handcrafted pizzas, shareable small plates, and a curated wine and craft cocktail list in a relaxed setting in the heart of historic downtown Ennis.

restaurants.name: Bailey's Cafe

restaurants.name: The Green Room

restaurants.address: 211 W Knox St, 2nd Floor, Ennis, TX 75119

restaurants.name: Sugar Ridge Winery
restaurants.type: Family-owned Texas winery and tasting room
restaurants.description: A rural winery near Bristol producing 20-plus handcrafted sweet and fruit-forward wines on-site, with patio seating and occasional live acoustic music; open weekends, call ahead to confirm hours.

hotels.name: Hampton Inn & Suites Ennis
hotels.description: Full-service Hilton-brand hotel offering complimentary hot breakfast, an indoor pool, and easy access to the Texas Motorplex and downtown Ennis.

hotels.name: Motel 6 Ennis
hotels.description: Affordable roadside motel convenient to I-45, well-placed for travelers heading to the Texas Motorplex or exploring the Ennis area.

shops.name: Fern In The Wild Boutique
shops.description: Gift shop inside the Fern In The Wild restaurant carrying locally inspired gifts, art pieces, and specialty items for weekend browsing.

shops.name: Ennis Farmers Market
shops.description: Saturday morning market running 8 a.m. to noon on Dallas Street, featuring local produce, crafts, live music, and kids' activities.

artEntertainment.name: Galaxy Drive-In Theatre
artEntertainment.description: A nine-screen drive-in movie theater open seven nights a week on the north side of Ennis, with digital projection, FM radio sound, and a full concession stand; box office opens at 6:00 p.m.

artEntertainment.name: Texas Motorplex
artEntertainment.type: Drag racing facility and entertainment venue
artEntertainment.description: The first NHRA super track, a 50,000-capacity facility hosting the annual Texas NHRA FallNationals each October and the Stars of Texas Music Festival, among other events year-round.

artEntertainment.name: Ennis Railroad and Cultural Heritage Museum
artEntertainment.description: Traces Ennis's origins as a railroad town with depot replicas, railroad memorabilia, vintage Czech dolls, china from historic rail lines, and a video history of the city's founding in 1872.

artEntertainment.name: Ennis Public Theatre
artEntertainment.description: A local performing-arts group producing live stage shows roughly every other month in a renovated historic venue in downtown Ennis.

gymsRecreation.name: Lake Bardwell
gymsRecreation.type: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers reservoir
gymsRecreation.description: A 3,500-acre lake and the largest recreational attraction in Ellis County, offering boating, fishing, water skiing, swimming, and picnicking at High View Park, with annual attendance exceeding 150,000.

gymsRecreation.name: Lion Tennis Center
gymsRecreation.description: One of the finest publicly accessible tennis complexes in Texas, operated by Ennis ISD, featuring nine championship courts including four indoor courts.
